title: iPD research findings file
description: One research file (research/R<n>_<slug>.yaml) = a list of atomic finding records, one obligation per record, sorted by id (workflow_plan section 3). This schema covers structure, types and enums. Semantic rules (quote fewer than 15 words, loc grammar, src key in registry or notes, id prefix = file stem, unique and sorted ids, ICH never binding-law, draft requires guidance, binding findings need page or [verify]) are enforced by tools/lint_findings.py.

id.description: Stem prefix + 3 digits, never reused. R9 is reserved for test fixtures and accepted by the linter only under fixtures/.

src.description: Key from contracts/source_registry.yaml, or a new key (UPPER-CASE with hyphens) listed under 'New source keys' in the stem's Rn_notes.md.

doc.description: Title, version, date of the document actually read.

url.description: URL actually fetched, or [verify] if not confirmed.

loc.description:
Grammar: P | GL: | A1- | A2- | AppB- | AppC- | Art. (

) | 21CFR.(

) | S; optional trailing ' [verify]'. Enforced by the linter (rule LOC).

loc_alt.description: Numbering in the other version (E6R3-S4), same grammar, or empty.

page.description: e.g. 'printed 12 / PDF 14', or '[verify]'. Required in substance for binding-law and binding-ICH findings (rule PAGE).

quote.description: Optional verbatim quote, fewer than 15 words, confirmed by a second fetch (rule QUOTE).

draft.description: true only for draft guidance; then binding must be 'guidance' (rule DRAFT).

binding_route.description: e.g. 'EU: <how>; US: <how>'. Mandatory in substance for ICH sources.

jurisdiction.description: Non-regional sources (industry best practice, data standards) use ICH = international scope (contracts/decisions.md S0-05).

party.description: Verbatim role term from the source.

themes.description: Canonical spellings: CtQ, RBQM, safety, data. Further tags allowed; case variants of the canonical ones are flagged (rule THEME, warning).
